infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KLMCE ERP needs access to your camera to scan QR codes for class attendance and physical credentials.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KLMCE ERP requires your location to validate geofenced check-ins for exams and classrooms.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: KLMCE ERP uses Face ID to securely authenticate your session and protect sensitive academic records.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow KLMCE ERP to use Face ID for secure authentication.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow KLMCE ERP to use your location for attendance.
